info.name: Robylon Webhooks (Wint IR Portal)
info.description:
Collection of incoming webhook events from Robylon for the Wint Wealth IR Portal.

Events included:
1. TICKET_CLOSED (Transcript & Chat Ingestion)
2. CLASSIFICATION_UPDATED (Dispositions L1/L2 - triggers scoring)
3. CSAT_SUBMITTED (Customer Rating)
4. CC_VOICE_CALL_COMPLETE (Call recording via chat webhook)
5. Direct Call Webhook (/api/webhooks/call)
6. Legacy Flat Webhook (/api/webhooks/chat)

request.description:
Robylon TICKET_CLOSED event.
- Extracts transcript messages, timestamps, and customer phone number
- Calculates First Response Time (FRT) and handling times
- Upserts contact and agent in PostgreSQL
- If classifications are already present, immediately triggers IQS scoring

Robylon CLASSIFICATION_UPDATED event.
- Sets disposition (L1) and sub_disposition (L2) tags on the conversation
- If transcript already exists from TICKET_CLOSED, immediately executes LLM scoring

Robylon CSAT_SUBMITTED event.
- Supported ratings: "good" / "5", "could be better" / "ok" / "3", "bad" / "1"
- Updates csat_score and csat_label on conversations

Robylon CC_VOICE_CALL_COMPLETE event.
- Sent when an agent finishes a voice call linked to a customer
- Kicks off background audio download & Gemini multimodal transcription

Dedicated call recording endpoint (/api/webhooks/call).
- Returns 202 status: processing
- Processes audio transcription and dead air / interruption metrics
